In addition, we may need to hire more personnel than we currently anticipate to support our operations and growth initiatives, and any resulting increases in labor costs could adversely affect our margins and operating results.
We have increased and expect to continue to increase our manufacturing headcount in connection with the expansion of our business.
We expect to continue to invest substantial resources to support our growth and anticipate our operating expenses will increase in absolute dollar amounts for the foreseeable future.
We have increased and expect to continue to increase our sales and marketing personnel in connection with the expansion of our business.

We also expect to incur additional expenses related to becoming publicly traded, including additional directors’ and officers’ liability insurance, director fees, additional expenses associated with complying with the reporting requirements of the SEC, transfer agent fees, costs relating to additional accounting, legal and administrative personnel, increased auditing, tax and legal fees, stock exchange listing…

We expect that as we continue to grow both our revenues and our general and administrative personnel, we will require additional property and equipment to support this growth resulting in additional depreciation expenses.

The period-to-period comparisons of our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected in the future, including for the reasons described above under “—Key Factors Affecting Our Performance.”

As the Company communicated last month, first quarter results exceeded the high end of its guidance ranges for revenues and Adjusted EBITDA, as strong production ramp execution drove higher throughput and better cost absorption.

“Based on our strong first quarter commercial and operational execution, together with backlog that fully covers our fiscal 2027 guidance, we are raising our full-year outlook,” said Gary Niederpruem, Chief Executive Officer of Forgent.
“Robust customer demand and strong execution on our production ramp give us greater confidence in our higher outlook.

We are also gaining meaningful traction with multiple frontier AI labs and hyperscalers through our direct sales strategy, and we expect orders from these important customers to build through fiscal 2027 and into fiscal 2028.”
